description:
Install the system dependencies a migration left behind - the apt packages (fonts,
    shared libraries, poppler/zip/node...), the patched-Qt wkhtmltox package chosen by the
    architecture THE BOX REPORTS, and the python libraries the client's addons import.
    Take the arguments from `sysdeps_inspect`'s `plan`.

    Additive: it installs, it never removes. dry_run=True (default) shows the exact
    script; confirm=True runs it after that preview has been shown. Odoo is restarted at
    the end because it decides AT STARTUP whether it has a PDF renderer - installing the
    tool under a running server changes nothing until then.

    `sha256` optionally pins the wkhtmltox download. None is baked in on purpose: a
    fingerprint invented here would be worse than none at all.
name: sysdeps_install
